## Snack Foods to Quell Your Hunger

Snacks are a pantry staple in many households. Grab-and-go goodies make it easy to keep hunger in check as you attend to obligations or send the kids off to school, and savory and sweet favorites are fun for family movie nights or to satisfy late-night munchies. Keeping your shelves stocked with delicious snack foods can help you stave off hangry attitudes and manage blood sugar levels.

## **Must-Have Snack Foods**

Every person's must-have snack foods differ depending on the tastes and textures they enjoy and their health and nutrition needs. You can find plenty of options at CVS, including favorites from brands such as [Snack Pack](https://www.cvs.com/shop/brand-shop/s/snack-pack), Nature Valley and Well Market.

Stock up on snacks for every taste, including:

- **Salty:** Pack your pantry with potato and corn chips. Individual serving bags make it easy to control portions, and family-size bags provide enough salty goodness for parties. Other salty favorites include cashews, peanuts and popcorn.

- **Sweet:** Satisfy a sweet tooth with chocolate and candy bars, hard candies and gummies or packaged cookies and cakes. You can also get boxed mixes or [baking supplies](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/pantry/baking-supplies) to make your own sweet baked goods.

- **Savory:** Explore unique flavors, such as herb or parmesan crackers. These make great additions to charcuterie boards for a fancier snack time.


## **On-the-Go Snacks for Busy Lifestyles**

Prepackaged on-the-go snacks provide numerous benefits for individuals, couples and families. When you can grab and go, you're less likely to splurge on more expensive snacks when you're out. Prepackaged nuts, granola bars and dried fruit mixes offer healthier choices, and individually wrapped cookies and snack cakes let you treat yourself or your kids without increasing your budget when running errands.

You can easily customize your snack supplies to meet lifestyle requirements when you shop prepackaged items. For instance, nuts and chips don't melt in a warm bag, and individually wrapped servings help keep your on-the-go snack supplies from making a mess in your bag. Parents with picky eaters can also choose specific items for each child when packing lunches or afternoon snacks.

## **Healthy Snacks for Mindful Eating**

For those who are working on more mindful eating, healthy snacks are certainly an option. Start by considering options packed with protein, fiber and other essential nutrients, ensuring your 3 p.m. snack break helps optimize your daily intake of good energy. Some snack categories that might fit this goal include [trail mix](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/snacks/snack-trail-mix), granola bars and nuts.

By browsing healthy snacks, you can also choose items to soothe cravings for less healthy options. Nature Valley or think! bars can serve a sweet tooth without the high amounts of sugar found in a chocolate bar. Veggie straws in a variety of flavors can help you head off a need for the salty goodness of French fries.

## Beverages for Hydration, Energy and Nutrition

Enjoy beverages for all occasions. Whether you're craving hot coffee for comfort on a cold day or a protein shake to help maximize your gym results, beverages are the convenient way to support nutrition and well-being.

## **Popular Drinks for Every Taste**

Our range of popular drinks includes products that appeal to almost any taste, so whether you prefer herbal tea or you're looking for a refreshing glass of [juice](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/juices) to beat the summer heat, you're bound to find something you love.

The weather often affects beverage choices the most. Warm green tea makes cold days easier to manage. However, when the temperatures become scorching, turn to sparkling [water](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/water) or sports drinks to assist with hydration and make you more comfortable.

Looking to avoid added calories or sugar? Stock up on [sugar-free beverages](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/q/Sugar_Free/cn) and lean protein shakes to help you stick to your fitness and lifestyle goals.

## **Exciting Beverage Options to Choose From**

Hydration doesn't need to be boring. While there's nothing wrong with a refreshing drink of water, you could also spice up your afternoon with flavored versions. Compared to [soda](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/soda), flavored water has a hint of berry or citrus, offering a lighter refreshment that doesn't overwhelm your taste buds.

If you're looking for something more intense, consider our specialty teas and [energy drinks](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/sport-energy-drinks). In addition to their exciting flavors, herbal teas often help with sleep, digestion and inflammation. Many people swear by [ginger](https://www.cvs.com/shop/content/ginger-root) for nausea, while hibiscus contains vitamin C, which may help improve immunity and skin health.

You can also make regular coffee or tea more interesting with unique milk and creamer choices. Try almond milk or plant-based [coffee creamer](https://www.cvs.com/shop/content/coffee-creamer) for the perfect way to help make your morning brew richer without dairy.

## **Refreshing Drinks for Every Occasion**

A refreshing beverage helps you feel more energized almost anytime. Start summer days on the right path with iced coffee or tea.

As your day continues, turn to other forms of refreshment for much-needed variety. While you've likely heard how helpful sports drinks can be for rehydrating after jogging or weightlifting, they also offer a tasty way to deal with the heat while working or performing home DIY.

If busy days are the norm, try a nutrition shake to help meet your vitamin and mineral needs. [Protein shakes](https://www.cvs.com/shop/diet-nutrition/protein/protein-drinks-shakes) are great to support your body, too, whether you've just finished a gym session or need a quick, healthy snack at any point.

## Healthy Snacks

Satisfy your taste buds without compromising on your diet by noshing healthy snacks from CVS.  Whether you need healthy snacks for weight loss, are concerned about salt intake or require gluten-free options, our selection has something tasty and hearty that fits your lifestyle. Choose options for toddlers, children and adults to ensure everyone in your family has the savory or sweet healthy snacks they love the most.

## What Are the Healthiest Snacks?

When it comes to healthy snacks, the best ones accommodate your diet. For instance, if you want healthy snacks for weight loss, consider options like sugar-free cookies or beef jerky. Low-sodium options, such as salt-free [nuts](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/snacks/nuts), provide a satisfying crunch without the potential water retention, while healthy snacks like protein bars offer an extra energy boost without the candy bar crash. Plant-based snacks ensure vegetarians and vegans have healthy snacking choices, while non-GMO and certified organic options offer added peace of mind.

## What Are Healthy Snacks for Diabetics?

Sugar-free snacks are usually the healthiest snacks for diabetics. Similar to healthy snacks for weight loss, those with diabetes typically fare better with sugar-free options. A handful of [trail mix](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/snacks/snack-trail-mix)  is a good choice for diabetics, as are low-carbohydrate options like meat sticks and beef jerky. Healthy snacks for diabetics also include nuts like almonds and pistachios. Freeze-dried fruit with a low-glycemic index also rates highly when you're searching for sweet healthy snacks for diabetics.

## Where Can I Buy Healthy Snacks?

When you're picking up your prescriptions in person or ordering your refills online for delivery, you can purchase healthy snacks from CVS. We offer a wide range of healthy snacks for weight loss plus certified organic and non-GMO options, providing flavorful foods from high-quality brands such as Gold Emblem, Pure Protein and KIND. Our selection includes everything from pretzels, applesauce and chocolate-covered nuts or seeds to [cereals](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/cereal-breakfast) and candies, ensuring a variety of both savory and sweet healthy snacks. Pick large containers well suited to snacking at home, or choose individually wrapped healthy snacks, such as bars and nuts, for when you need a quick bite on the go.

## Stock Your Kitchen With Pantry Staples

Set the scene for your next culinary escapade with pantry staples from CVS. Shop for essential pantry items, such as flour, condiments and canned goods, and build your perfect pantry one shelf at a time.

## **Build Your Perfect Pantry With Pantry Staples**

Having a well-stocked kitchen, including cabinets full of pantry essentials, can be your ticket to a whole slate of easy meals. It all starts with canned goods that form the foundation of weekday cooking. A quick bowl of soup for lunch or a medley of canned vegetables and beans over rice for dinner delivers plenty of nutrients without long cook times.

Always be ready to bake a birthday treat or whip up a platter of your signature pancakes with a pantry full of baking basics. Stow flour, sugar and baking powder in [food storage containers](https://www.cvs.com/shop/household/paper-plastic/food-storage-containers) that help seal in freshness, so you can quickly scoop and have those apple cinnamon muffins ready in time for lunch.

Round out your bucket list of pantry staples with a cache of condiments. Choose from a variety of mustards, ketchups, mayonnaises and pickled accompaniments to add zest to everything from sub sandwiches to fried chicken.

## **Spices and Seasonings for Every Dish**

Amp up the flavor of your favorite dishes with pantry items designed to add zest and zip. Classics, such as Italian seasoning and [Gold Emblem Pure Vanilla Extract](https://www.cvs.com/shop/gold-emblem-pure-vanilla-extract-1-oz-prodid-851306), hold the key to a celebrated lasagna or a potluck-ready slow-cooker cheesecake. Stock up on salt-and-pepper duos to season food at home, at a picnic or in your camper.

Complement foundational seasonings, such as onion powder and ground cinnamon, with all-purpose blends that elevate everything from tuna salad to scrambled eggs. Even a simple squirt of bottled lemon or lime juice can be a revelation. Add a spritz to [sparkling water](https://www.cvs.com/shop/grocery/beverages/water) for a simple yet refreshing bubbly drink.

## **Sweeten Your Cooking and Baking**

No collection of pantry staples is complete without a diverse array of sweeteners. Brown sugar for your BBQ rubs, powdered sugar for homemade icing, maple syrup for the nooks and crannies in your [Toastmaster Mini Waffle Maker](https://www.cvs.com/shop/toastmaster-mini-waffle-maker-prodid-629775) — there are endless applications for these sweet additives. Honey and agave nectar are useful for cocktails, salad dressings and glazes, dissolving quickly and adding a rich, fragrant layer to your latest creation.

For healthy alternatives to traditional sugar, explore sugar-free substitutes. Zero-calorie sweeteners come in bulk bags or individual packets, giving you the freedom to DIY your coffee and tea at home, at work and on the road.
